messages.subject: Whitcombe - executed settlement agreement & payment breakdown
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Please find attached (1) the executed settlement agreement, and (2) a breakdown of the settlement and the tax treatment for payroll. The £30,000 termination element is paid free of tax under ss.401-403 ITEPA; PAYE should be applied to the £78,000 compensatory element at the appropriate rate. The total cost to the Company, including the £15,000 costs contribution, is £123,000.

With the agreement signed and the advice given, the matter is now concluded subject to payment and the withdrawal being processed by the Tribunal. It's been a pleasure - do let me know if anything else is needed.

Best wishes,
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0538

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
